entities.summary: Heinrich Eugen Waentig was a German economist and politician. Waentig was born in Zwickau, Saxony. Between 1888 and 1893, he studied at several universities, including University of Munich, University of Berlin, University of Leipzig, and University of Vienna, earning his doctorate at Leipzig. He later traveled to the United States and East Asia.
